notes:
CentraFlow 1.3.0 (build 8)

Added
- Study hub with exams and preparation checklists, grade goals and custom percentage scales.
- Academic terms, separate weekday study windows, study-plan proposals and workload previews.
- Offline flashcards, timed multiple-choice practice with saved answers, and practice priorities based on missed questions.
- Selected-image text recognition, a task confirmation inbox, local material search and consent-based passage Q&A.
- Topic links, portable backup/restore with optional password encryption, and private recovery copies.
- Android home-screen widget with optional planner details and a Focus shortcut.
- Settings app updates: version checks, optional notifications, verified APK downloads and Android installation approval.
- Optional encrypted personal-vault sync client. Its separate service still needs setup and is not live.

Included fixes
- Independent database connections for background work, prompt loading-error Retry, and safer optional subject links.
- AI copies show only the readable result; original notes and source archives remain preserved.
- AI refinement instructions preserve negation, dates and quantities; answers still need review.

Installation
Download the APK and install over CentraFlow without uninstalling or clearing its data. This first updater-enabled version must be installed once from this link; later published versions can be downloaded from Settings > App updates. Android asks for installation permission and confirmation.

Verification and limits
Release build and existing signing certificate verified. 106 Flutter tests passed, followed by 13 targeted tests including 3 new cases (109 unique checks); analysis is clean. Live synthetic Q&A and refinement completed successfully. No production planner data was used in testing.
Physical-phone upgrade, OCR, widget, installer and background-notification acceptance remain. The existing personal-test signing identity is retained. Sync is prepared only; no paid upgrade is enabled. Cards, question banks and topic links are entered or confirmed by the user.
